name: Home Row Warm-up
description: Eight short lines that stay on the home row, for a slow and steady warm-up.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight home-row lines for a calm typing warm-up, shown on Typing Drills.
help.goal: Just a warm-up. There is no score to beat.
howToPlay: Rest your fingers on the middle row of the keyboard.
Type the line shown. Correct letters are underlined and mistakes are struck through.
At the end of a line the next one appears. Use Start line over or Skip line any time.
tips: Slow is fine. What you type never leaves this page.
